title: P0.90: UI Display Goal Context SQLite Budget
description: Prevent startup/provider-health display paths from blocking the UI on objective_repository SQLite reads.
reason: Live shortcut proof after P0.89 produced a 5728ms ui_event_loop_stall. The sampled main-thread stack was _apply_task_result(provider_health) -> _startup_readiness_text() -> _goal_context_for_display() -> objective_repository.latest_active() -> SQLite busy_timeout. CPU/RAM appeared usable, but the UI thread waited on persistent goal context.
next_action: Merge P0.90, update the desktop shortcut runtime, launch IABV from the shortcut, and verify provider_health no longer causes ui_event_loop_stall with objective_repository in the sampled stack.
resume_hint: Display paths now call _goal_context_for_display(..., allow_repository=false) and schedule a background goal_context refresh instead of querying SQLite from readiness text, provider diagnostics, or agent card building.
